title: 1983 AHSME Problem 9
statement: In a certain population the ratio of the number of women to the number of men is \(11\) to \(10.\) If the average (arithmetic mean) age of the women is \(34\) and the average age of the men is \(32,\) then the average age of the population is

solutions.text:
Using \(11\) women and \(10\) men, the total of all ages is \(11\cdot34+10\cdot32=694.\) Dividing by \(21\) people gives \(\frac{694}{21}=33\frac1{21}.\)

Therefore, the correct answer is D.
hints: Use groups of \(11\) women and \(10\) men
Divide \(11\cdot34+10\cdot32\) by the total number of people
